behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.38.0 for the fixes of the code review of 2026-10-31: the scratch and spool chains take only the operator's own directory; a revoked host key is refused host_key_revoked under every policy, and a @cert-authority or other marked line enrols no key; karvi-prune --days takes 1 to 999, and a root it cannot read fails the run (exit 1); askpass answers the login's username and password alone (askpass_prompt_unrecognized), askpass_enable_password_unset retired for privilege_failed, and karvi login resolves no enable secret; run --exercise refuses a configuration that keeps no job folder (run_mode_conflict); the configuration's TOML reads strings, integers, and floats as TOML does (config_toml_syntax); display.timestamp writes what its pattern says, mm between a date and a time token refused display_timestamp_mm_ambiguous; two inventory rows for one device are one only when every field agrees (inventory_conflict); .cloginrc lines, words, patterns, and passwords are read as clogin's Tcl reads them; a link at a day folder, a job folder, its commands folder, a capacity ledger's lock, or its devices folder is refused; a [platform.NAME] table's fields are checked against the registry's kinds (config_type_error, config_platform_telnet_port_out_of_range) and legacy-class is refused config_unknown_key; a locked key takes its macros from the global configuration alone (config_lock_violation); a formula backend's password source, the record templates, and a transform's keys are checked at load; config show --explain judges the capacity root and the scoreboards as a run does; registry 33 moves, every other counter is 0.38.0's (configuration schema 6, execution plan 15, daemon IPC 12, command record 4, job manifest and summary 5, plan report 4, credential package 2, scoreboard 5, audit 2); goldmark v1.8.7, for the documents alone, Go and the other modules are 0.38.0's; the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.38.0 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.38.0 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
